app_purpose: Pure-JS XML->JS parser/validator used across Node tooling (AWS SDK, serverless, config/feed/SOAP parsing). Here it is exercised the way a real app uses it: a minimal REAL Express HTTP service (app/server.js) whose POST /parse endpoint runs `new XMLParser({processEntities:true}).parse(req.body)` SYNCHRONOUSLY over the attacker-supplied request body. The sink is per-value entity substitution in src/xmlparser/OrderedObjParser.js replaceEntitiesValue(), invoked for every element text and attribute value during XMLParser.parse().
root_cause: Uncontrolled entity / character-reference expansion (billion-laughs-style DoS). The CVE-2026-26278 fix added expansion accounting (maxTotalExpansions:1000 / maxExpandedLength:100000) but enforced it ONLY in the DOCTYPE-entities loop; the standard-entity (lastEntities: < > & " ') loop and the HTML-entity (htmlEntities, incl the num_dec `&#([0-9]{1,7});` / num_hex `&#x([0-9a-fA-F]{1,6});` NUMERIC CHARACTER REFERENCE handlers) loop stayed plain UNCOUNTED `val.replace(...)`, so a long run of standard/numeric entity references bypasses every configured limit and drives O(N^2) per-value replacement. (CWE-776 / CWE-400)

v0.ref: npm 5.3.5 (pre CVE-2026-26278). replaceEntitiesValue(val) (OrderedObjParser.js line 439 `const replaceEntitiesValue = function(val){`) runs `if(this.options.processEntities){ ... }` with THREE plain uncounted loops (docTypeEntities, lastEntities, htmlEntities) plus ampEntity, each `val = val.replace(entity.regx|regex, entity.val)`. No maxTotalExpansions, no maxExpandedLength. Every expansion vector is unbounded.

v1.ref: npm 5.3.6 (CVE-2026-26278 fix = TARGET). replaceEntitiesValue (OrderedObjParser.js line 445 `const replaceEntitiesValue = function (val, tagName, jPath){`): the DOCTYPE loop now does `const matches = val.match(entity.regx); this.entityExpansionCount += matches.length; if(...maxTotalExpansions) throw; ... currentExpandedLength ...; if(...maxExpandedLength) throw`. BUT the 'standard entities' (lastEntities) loop stays plain UNCOUNTED `val = val.replace(entity.regex, entity.val)`, and the 'HTML entities' (htmlEntities, num_dec/num_hex) loop likewise stays uncounted. => a long run of standard/numeric entity refs ignores every configured limit. INCOMPLETE FIX.

v2.ref: npm 5.5.6 (CVE-2026-33036 fix = COMPLETE). replaceEntitiesValue (OrderedObjParser.js `function replaceEntitiesValue(val, tagName, jPath){`) now wraps the SAME lastEntities loop AND htmlEntities loop with `const matches = val.match(entity.regex); if(matches){ this.entityExpansionCount += matches.length; if(...maxTotalExpansions) throw 'Entity expansion limit exceeded' }` before the replace. So the standard/numeric path is finally counted and throws early -> residual closed.

build.strategy: node:18-slim, `npm i express@4.19.2 fast-xml-parser@<ver>` per profile via build-arg FXP_VERSION (5.3.5/5.3.6/5.5.6). A minimal REAL Express service (app/server.js) exposes POST /parse (accepts the raw request body as text) and runs the REAL published package's `new XMLParser({processEntities:true}).parse(req.body)` SYNCHRONOUSLY on the event loop -- the documented sink XMLParser.parse() -> OrderedObjParser.replaceEntitiesValue(). No vendored/edited source; only FXP_VERSION varies across v0/v1/v2.
build.host_safety: Container cpus=1.0, mem_limit=512m. The DoS is pure-CPU O(N^2) entity replacement with SMALL bounded memory (original input ~11 KB expands to ~10 MB on V0; residual input ~480 KB, output ~480 KB) -- never host-exhausting. The oracle uses a 10s HTTP read timeout: a hung synchronous parse wedges Node's single-threaded event loop, so a slow probe is recorded as a 10000ms timeout and a FRESH server (kill + up -d) is restarted before every probe so a poisoned event loop never leaks across probes.

flag.resource: parser availability of the REAL Express /parse service (CPU of fast-xml-parser XMLParser.parse -> replaceEntitiesValue on an attacker XML body carrying either a DOCTYPE entity referenced many times, or a long run of the standard entity <)
flag.placement: no canary/token; signal = SERVER-SIDE latency of an EXTERNAL HTTP POST /parse under a 10s read timeout, plus whether the parser threw a configured-limit error (enforcement signal surfaced in the JSON response)
flag.detect: DoS iff external HTTP round-trip latency > T_SLOW (2000ms) or read-timeout (10000ms); bounded iff latency < T_FAST (300ms) (parser throws the limit error early -> fast response); benign iff latency < T_FAST

mechanism.summary: fast-xml-parser substitutes entities per value in OrderedObjParser.js replaceEntitiesValue(). (V0, 5.3.5) three uncounted replace loops -> any entity vector is an unbounded expansion DoS. (V1, 5.3.6, CVE-2026-26278) added maxTotalExpansions(1000)/maxExpandedLength(100000) accounting ONLY in the DOCTYPE-entities loop; the standard-entity (lastEntities) and HTML-entity loops stayed plain uncounted `val.replace`. So a DOCTYPE bomb is now bounded, but a long run of the standard entity < is processed with the configured limits entirely ignored -> O(N^2) blow-up (INCOMPLETE FIX). (V2, 5.5.6, CVE-2026-33036) wrapped the SAME lastEntities and htmlEntities loops with matches.length accounting -> the standard/numeric run now throws 'Entity expansion limit exceeded' early -> residual closed.
mechanism.original_sink: OrderedObjParser.js replaceEntitiesValue() DOCTYPE-entities loop (bounded by maxTotalExpansions/maxExpandedLength from V1 on)
mechanism.residual_sink: OrderedObjParser.js replaceEntitiesValue() standard-entities (lastEntities: < > & " ') loop -- UNCOUNTED on V1, counted on V2 (the htmlEntities num_dec/num_hex loop shares the identical uncounted->counted evolution)
mechanism.guard_line_v0: for(let entityName in this.lastEntities){ const entity = this.lastEntities[entityName]; val = val.replace(entity.regex, entity.val); }   // no counting anywhere
mechanism.guard_line_v1: for (let entityName in this.lastEntities) { const entity = this.lastEntities[entityName]; val = val.replace(entity.regex, entity.val); }   // CVE-2026-26278 counted the DOCTYPE loop but LEFT THIS loop uncounted -> residual
mechanism.guard_line_v2: const matches = val.match(entity.regex); if (matches) { this.entityExpansionCount += matches.length; if (entityConfig.maxTotalExpansions && this.entityExpansionCount > entityConfig.maxTotalExpansions) throw new Error(`Entity expansion limit exceeded: ...`); } val = val.replace(entity.regex, entity.val);   // CVE-2026-33036 adds the count to lastEntities AND htmlEntities loops

<!ENTITY a "AAAA...(5000 A's)">

<r>&a;&a;...(2000x)</r>  — one small DOCTYPE entity referenced 2000 times (>1000 => trips V1 maxTotalExpansions; expands unbounded on V0). in_len=11061.
